title: Private deployment - ACME weekly sync 2026-06-01
content:
Notes: Weekly sync with ACME (private deployment) - 1hr
Attendees: Aisha Patel (SE owner), Tom Garcia (ACME infra lead), Leah Wong (Redwood SRE), Michael Chen (Redwood PM), Samir Rao (Redwood deploy eng)

Agenda:
- Quick status / milestones
- VPC peering & routing
- On-prem install progress
- Security & compliance (KMS, audit logs)
- Blockers & action items
- Next steps

Summary:
- Overall status: Yellow - behind on on-prem install due to site access window and firewall rules. VPC peering progressing.

Milestones / Status:
- VPC peering (RDW-4821) - owner: Leah Wong - status: in_progress - notes: peering established in staging, awaiting ACL updates from ACME network team. Expected completion: 2026-06-04.
- KMS integration (RDW-4902) - owner: Michael Chen - status: blocked_until_acme_key_rotation - notes: ACME to rotate keys; Redwood ready to validate once rotated.
- On-prem installer run #2 - owner: Tom Garcia (ACME) & Samir Rao (deploy eng) - status: delayed - notes: site access window moved to 2026-06-03; installer failing at kubelet registration step (error: node-taint mismatch). Suspect mismatch in kubelet config.
- Observability agent (Promtail) rollout - owner: Leah Wong - status: done in staging, pending prod - notes: need log forwarding endpoint from ACME (ELK URL).
- Rollout plan / canary - owner: Aisha Patel - status: on_track - notes: canary plan drafted, will start with 2 nodes after on-prem install success.

Blockers / Risks:
1) Firewall/ACL changes delayed by ACME network approvals - impact: blocks VPC peering finalization and KMS egress testing.
2) Kubelet registration errors on on-prem cluster - blocks installer completion.
3) KMS key rotation scheduling - until rotated cannot validate encryption at rest.
4) Access to customer ELK endpoint for logs - delays observability end-to-end testing.

Action items (owner - due):
- ACME network to provide ACL diff and ETA (Tom Garcia - 2026-06-03)
- Redwood SRE to validate kubelet config and provide patched installer (Samir Rao, Leah Wong - 2026-06-02)
- ACME security to confirm KMS rotation window and share rotated key id (Tom Garcia - 2026-06-04)
- Michael Chen to add validation step for KMS keys to installer and share test plan (Michael Chen - 2026-06-05)
- Leah to collect ELK ingest endpoint and credentials from ACME (Leah Wong - 2026-06-03)
- Aisha to update canary runbook with rollback thresholds and share with ACME (Aisha Patel - 2026-06-06)

Decisions made:
- Canary will be 2 nodes, 10% traffic, 24hr observation window. Stop conditions: >2% error rate or latency p99 > 2x baseline.
- Use temporary SSH bastion for on-prem troubleshooting (ACME-approved until 2026-06-10).

Open questions:
- Who will own node patching schedule in ACME on-prem environment? (Tom to confirm)
- Can ACME provide a test dataset for latency/cost profiling? (Mike/PM to request)

Prep for next sync (2026-06-08):
- ACME to share ACL update or blocker status prior to meeting.
- Redwood to present patched installer logs and KMS validation results.

Notes to self / scratch:
- Follow up with Samir on kubelet error trace: send logs + systemd output.
- Draft follow-up email for Tom summarizing action items (send 2026-06-01 EOD).
- Add RDW-4821 to sprint board if blocker persists past 2026-06-04.

Quick links:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/ACME-CONTRACT
- Jira: JIRA-RDW-4821, JIRA-RDW-4902
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/PR/334

Timestamp: 2026-06-01 10:15 PDT
